*** Add File: extract_json.py
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "openai/gpt-5.4-mini")
+
+
+def _messages(text: str, schema: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
+    system = "Extract structured JSON from the provided text. Return only valid JSON."
+    if schema is not None:
+        system += " Match this schema as closely as possible: " + json.dumps(schema, ensure_ascii=False)
+    user = text
+    return [
+        {"role": "system", "content": system},
+        {"role": "user", "content": user},
+    ]
+
+
+def extract_json(text: str, schema: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Any:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "messages": _messages(text, schema),
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=120)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    return json.loads(content)
+
*** End Patch

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: summarize_text.py
+import os
+from typing import Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def summarize_text(text: str, max_sentences: int = 3, model: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    model_id = model or os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini")
+    prompt = f"Summarize the following text in at most {max_sentences} sentences. Focus on the key points and preserve important details.\n\n{text}"
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=model_id,
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "You are a concise and accurate summarization assistant.",
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
+        ],
+    )
+    return response.output_text.strip()
*** End Patch
